title: Large language models for breast cancer treatment planning: a blinded real-world evaluation of DeepSeek, ChatGPT, and oncologist recommendations.
summary: In a blinded review of 213 breast-cancer records, experts compared plans generated by DeepSeek V3.1 and ChatGPT-5 with the historical oncologist plans. DeepSeek received higher guideline-concordance scores, and agreement was weaker in advanced-stage cases.
ai_technology: LLMs generate treatment recommendations from de-identified records for blinded expert scoring.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Three expert reviewers rated plans from historical cases and compared concordance across cancer stages.
evidence.unknown: The study measured retrospective agreement with guidelines and clinicians. Patient outcomes were outside its design.
evidence.ai_role: LLMs generate treatment recommendations from de-identified records for blinded expert scoring.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
